card.name: Oral before granules, solution, pellets
card.fires_on: The word oral (or a brand-name ending) right after a drug name or packet/capsule, just before a dosage form such as granules, solution, pellets or tablets.

modes.label: Oral before dosage form

modes.label: Inside brand names before form

modes.label: Linking word in formulation phrases
modes.description: A short word within a phrase naming a formulation, such as a compounding heading.
